title: Walk through Biosphere 2’s living worlds
description: Biosphere 2 rises from the Arizona desert as a collection of enclosed environments built for experiments in ecology and sustainability. A self-paced tour leads you through its history and current research, from the rainforest to other engineered habitats. Notice the pipes, glass, and living systems together: the building is as much a machine as a garden.
teaser: Explore an experimental ecosystem near Tucson.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm tour route; walking, stairs and gradients may require adaptations.
whyItMightDelightYou: It makes the work of sustaining life visible in the walls and machinery around you.
